clauses.clause: When this creature enters, destroy target artifact or enchantment an opponent controls.
clauses.evidence: [cast] / [cast | ask 1 -> opp_charm]: 'ask target: [opp_relic, opp_charm]' (your own you_relic / you_charm and all creatures excluded); the chosen one 'moves battlefield -> graveyard (by card/DESTROY)'. Also fires when put onto the battlefield on the opponent's turn.
